deprecationPolicy: Machine identifiers remain compatibility contracts. New names must dual-read old identifiers, dual-write only when safe, publish migration telemetry, and remove old identifiers no earlier than the declared major version.

categories.description: Environment variables consumed by services, agents, charts and CI.
categories.compatibilityRisk: Breaking configuration, credential injection or operator automation.
categories.readPath: Process environment at service, agent, runner, webhook and chart startup.
categories.writePath: Helm values, Kubernetes manifests and CI workflow environment configuration.
categories.migrationStrategy: Add a canonical alias with dual-read precedence, document the alias, and retain the legacy variable through the next major.

categories.description: Go import and module paths under the compatibility namespace.
categories.compatibilityRisk: Breaking imports, generated SDK references and module consumers.
categories.readPath: Go module resolution and generated SDK imports.
categories.writePath: go.mod, go.sum, source imports and generated client metadata.
categories.migrationStrategy: Keep the module path stable; introduce any future path through a compatibility module and dual-publish generated clients.

categories.description: OCI repositories, Helm chart names, releases and runtime artifact names.
categories.compatibilityRisk: Unavailable images/charts, failed upgrades or orphaned release ownership.
categories.readPath: Helm dependency resolution, OCI pulls, release plans and deployment values.
categories.writePath: Chart metadata, image values, OCI publication workflows and Kubernetes release labels.
categories.migrationStrategy: Publish aliases and immutable digests, resolve new references in release plans, and retain old repositories until the next major.

categories.description: Kubernetes namespaces, resource names, ownership labels and API groups.
categories.compatibilityRisk: Lost ownership, RBAC mismatch, resource adoption failure or cross-tenant leakage.
categories.readPath: Kubernetes discovery, admission, ownership and status reconciliation.
categories.writePath: Rendered manifests, labels, annotations, namespaces and API type metadata.
categories.migrationStrategy: Dual-read labels and API aliases, write canonical plus compatibility metadata only within the owning namespace, and remove legacy selectors after the next major.

categories.description: CLI names, local configuration paths, commands and generated identifiers.
categories.compatibilityRisk: Broken operator scripts, local state discovery or automation callbacks.
categories.readPath: CLI argument parsing, local config discovery and webhook payload handling.
categories.writePath: CLI output, local state directories, generated branch/preview names and callback commands.
categories.migrationStrategy: Accept canonical and legacy forms during dual-read, emit canonical forms for new resources, and retain aliases through the next major.

categories.description: Webhook command paths and SCM callback command identifiers.
categories.compatibilityRisk: Dropped SCM events or duplicate environment transitions.
categories.readPath: Webhook HTTP routing and event command dispatch.
categories.writePath: Webhook routes, SCM callback URLs and emitted command payloads.
categories.migrationStrategy: Dual-route old and canonical commands, use idempotent dispatch, and remove the old route only in the next major.

categories.description: Database, metrics, queue, job and durable state identifiers.
categories.compatibilityRisk: Lost durable state, metric continuity, queue delivery or cleanup ownership.
categories.readPath: Database migrations, metric collectors, queue consumers and reconciliation state.
categories.writePath: Schema/table names, metric descriptors, queue topics, job names and release-plan state.
categories.migrationStrategy: Dual-read old and new durable identifiers, backfill or bridge records, preserve metric aliases, and remove old names only in the next major.

categories.description: External, documentation, callback and test URLs containing the compatibility namespace.
categories.compatibilityRisk: Broken callbacks, documentation links, probes or test fixtures.
categories.readPath: SCM/webhook configuration, browser routing, probes and integration fixtures.
categories.writePath: Configuration defaults, documentation, test fixtures and generated endpoint contracts.
categories.migrationStrategy: Publish canonical endpoints while dual-reading configured legacy URLs, then remove old URLs after consumers migrate and the next major is released.
